subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “Every Thursday after school, older students helped younger students with homework in the library.”?
options: New students often got lost during the first week of school.
Students with clean desks got a star.
Then students saw that it could support fairness.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「New students often got lost during the first week of school.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Younger students got support.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Students with clean desks got a star.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Then students saw that it could support fairness.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Younger students got support.」，答案為「Younger students got support.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Younger students got support.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
